name: ask-firmory
description: Share project files and context. Pick up where your team left off.

interface.longDescription:
Share project files, work produced by AI, and project context with your team and Codex in one workspace. Find existing work, understand the decisions behind it, and continue where teammates and their AI left off—without repeatedly transferring files or explaining project history.

Explore project memory and file relationships to understand how work developed and what it was based on. When referenced materials change, use these relationships to check which documents, code, or other deliverables may need updating.
defaultPrompt: Which projects can I access in my Firmory workspace?
Help me check which version of the brief a report was based on.
I’m revising a spec. Which documents were built from its current version?

zh-CN.subtitle: 共享项目文件与背景，接着团队已有的工作继续做。
zh-CN.description:
在同一个工作空间中，与团队和 Codex 共享项目文件、AI 成果和项目背景。查找已有成果，理解相关决策的依据，接着同事及其 AI 已经完成的工作继续做，减少反复传文件和解释项目历史。

通过项目记忆与文件关系，了解工作如何形成、依据哪些资料。当引用的资料发生变化时，可沿着引用关系，检查自己的文档、代码或其他交付成果是否需要调整。

zh-TW.subtitle: 共享專案檔案與背景，接續團隊已完成的工作。
zh-TW.description:
在同一個工作空間中，與團隊和 Codex 共享專案檔案、AI 成果和專案背景。找出已有的成果，了解相關決策的依據，接續同事及其 AI 已完成的工作，減少反覆傳檔或說明專案歷程。

透過專案記憶與檔案關係，了解工作如何形成、依據哪些資料。當引用的資料發生變化時，可循著引用關係，檢查自己的文件、程式碼或其他交付成果是否需要調整。
